svg.aria-label: An 8-bit pixel-art scene on a white background: a marketer sits at a small desk in front of one big CRT terminal, under a wall sign that reads MARKETING AS CODE — AGENTS AT WORK. On a loop they type the request FIND KEYWORDS WE CAN RANK FOR, hit return, and sit back to watch the SEO agent work: it calls DataForSEO and checks SERP ranks, each with a progress bar filling, then reports FOUND 12 GAPS with MARKETING AS CODE as the top one while the ranking chart on the wall climbs. Finally it queues three content briefs, the screen border flashes green with a checkmark, and the marketer throws their arms up under falling green confetti and gold coins before the session resets to a blinking cursor.
